title: Learned Terminal Costs for Short-Horizon Model Predictive Control of Autonomous Trucks in Interactive Highway Traffic
abstract: arXiv:2610.40257v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous highway driving for heavy-duty trucks is a challenging control problem. The greater mass, dimensions and intricate dynamics increase the requirements for cooperation from surrounding traffic in critical maneuvers, requiring a careful balance between safety constraints and efficient long-horizon decision making. Model Predictive Control (MPC) provides rigorous constraint satisfaction but relies on terminal cost which can limit its effectiveness at short, computationally affordable horizons. Reinforcement Learning (RL) captures long-term driving behavior but offers no constraint guarantees and tends toward overly conservative policies when trained under sparse collision penalties. In this paper, we propose a hybrid MPC and RL framework for highway driving in autonomous trucks, where a finite-horizon MPC, solved via dynamic programming, uses a pre-trained RL model for terminal cost estimation. translated_title: 面向交互式高速公路交通中自动驾驶卡车短时域模型预测控制的学习式终端代价
translated_abstract: 重型卡车的高速公路自动驾驶是一个具有挑战性的控制问题。更大的质量、车身尺寸以及复杂的动力学特性，使得关键机动动作对周围交通配合的要求更高，需要在安全约束与高效的长时域决策之间进行细致的权衡。模型预测控制（MPC）能够严格满足约束，但其有效性依赖于终端代价的设计，这在计算上可承受的短时域内会受到限制。强化学习（RL）能够捕捉长期驾驶行为，但不提供约束保证，并且在稀疏碰撞惩罚下训练时往往倾向于过于保守的策略。在本文中，我们提出了一种用于自动驾驶卡车高速公路行驶的MPC与RL混合框架，其中通过动态规划求解的有限时域MPC使用预训练的RL模型来进行终端代价估计。我们在仿真环境中对该框架进行了评估。
tldr: 提出一种MPC与RL混合框架，利用预训练的强化学习模型为有限时域模型预测控制提供终端代价估计，使自动驾驶卡车在计算可承受的短时域内既能严格满足安全约束，又能实现长时域的高效决策。
